mcp_tool_arguments.prompt:
Remove all tasks.json files and integrate their functionality directly into launch.json files. This involves:

1. Converting all tasks from tasks.json into inline preLaunchTask configurations within launch.json
2. Removing the tasks.json files after integration
3. Updating any references to task labels to use the new integrated approach
4. Ensuring all launch configurations continue to work properly

Found tasks.json files:
- /workspaces/semio/.vscode/tasks.json (716 lines, many build/test/dev tasks)
- /workspaces/semio/repo/vscode/.vscode/tasks.json (37 lines, simple dev task)

Corresponding launch.json files:
- /workspaces/semio/.vscode/launch.json (457 lines)
- /workspaces/semio/repo/vscode/.vscode/launch.json (16 lines)
